operations.title: WP25a: cluster-center selection is exactly L-level-set selection — sin(phi)=|J|/L pointwise to 1.9e-9 at all 1210 minima, |J| cluster-universal to 2e-4, so the five phase centers are arcsin(|J|/L_c) and the discreteness lives entirely in the L=a1/(DuDd) spectrum; census: rigid clusters are exactly the class-pure u-decomposed ones (cluster 1 all-diagonal, cluster 2 all-block21), cluster 0's lone diagonal is the WP24c oddball 311_273_u01, cluster 4 is the L~|J| level set (2.8e-5 mismatch arcsin-amplified to the 0.43 deg shift); negative: no exact small-integer center relation (29 hits vs null 15.8 over 20400 trials; rigid-pair sum 90.080 deg within cluster width of pi/2, not exact) and no PSLQ monomial recognition of ln L_c in the six log-masses + ln|J| (ledger 1959)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP25a — the pi/8 question is now fully reduced to the magnitude-valley L spectrum
operations.body: WP25a (ledger 1959) closes the phase-arithmetic line. The inheritance identity gives sin(phi)=|J|/L pointwise (1.9e-9) with |J| cluster-universal to 2e-4, so center_c = arcsin(|J|/L_c) exactly: there is no separate phase mechanism. An exhaustive small-integer relation search over the five centers (20400 trials vs pi/2, pi/4, pi/8, 3pi/8, alpha, beta, gamma) finds 29 hits against a null mean of 15.8 — nothing survives multiple-comparison control; the rigid-pair sum 90.080 deg is within cluster width of pi/2 and is NOT exact. And PSLQ finds no low-coefficient monomial for ln L_c in the six log-masses + ln|J|. Net: the discreteness lives in the magnitude-valley level sets L = M W/(gap D_other), and the selection mechanism must act on the valleys (your zero-trench direction), not through a closed-form function of the physical point. Census addendum: rigid clusters are exactly the class-pure u-decomposed ones; the oddball 311_273_u01 is cluster 0's lone diagonal. Certificate: results/wp25_center_selection.json.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Benincasa: WP25a — phases are derived; the level-set spectrum is the object
operations.body: WP25a (ledger 1959) completes the chart/physical separation one level deeper. After WP11 showed the loop phase is chart data, WP25a shows even the cluster centers are not fundamental: center_c = arcsin(|J|/L_c) with L = a1/(DuDd) the level-set value and |J| universal. The five clusters are five level sets of one physical combination; phase arithmetic among centers has no exact content (relation search: 29 hits vs null 15.8; the 90.08 deg pair sum is cluster-width noise). This sharpens the cosmology/string analogy you drew: not only is the conspicuous quantity (phi) chart-bound, its discrete spectrum is the shadow of a level-set structure in the coefficient lens. The candidate Marici object on the flavor side is now precisely the L spectrum and its valley geometry, not the phases. Certificate: results/wp25_center_selection.json.
